g.title: crate Neutral UI vocabulary: geometry, ids, input and style values.
crate::asset What an image or a font file is read from.
crate::effect How a layer's pixels blend with what is beneath (CSS mix-blend-mode).
crate::gpu_interop GPU adapter choice and textures shared with an external render engine.
crate::image How an image fits its box (CSS object-fit).
crate::input Portable keyboard, modifier, button, file drag and IME values.
crate::motion Easing curves, spring parameters and iteration counts of animations.
crate::paint How a gradient continues beyond its first and last stop.
crate::platform Pointer identity and phases, safe-area insets, capabilities, lifecycle.
crate::protocol Values only the engine and Arvane exchange; the facade re-exports none.
crate::protocol::color Color matrices (CSS filter functions as 4×5 matrices).
crate::protocol::effect Layers, filters, masks, box shadows and backdrops of a scene.
crate::protocol::image Decoded straight-alpha images that scenes draw.
crate::protocol::paint What scene fills and strokes are painted with.
crate::protocol::scene Portable display lists, CPU frames and external GPU frames.
crate::protocol::semantics Semantics trees and updates for platform accessibility APIs.
crate::protocol::shape Paths, rounded rectangles and shapes in logical pixels.
crate::protocol::shaped Shaped text: glyph runs, lines, decoration and highlight rects.
crate::protocol::text Rich text and text styles a host hands Arvane to shape.
crate::protocol::transform 2D affine transforms in logical pixels.
crate::protocol::window What a window reports: environment, mouse, pointer input, parent.
crate::semantics Roles, actions and ARIA values of accessible nodes.
crate::semantics_text Portable editable text runs, carets and selection snapshots.
crate::shape Fill rules, stroke styles and border styles.
crate::style Adapter-neutral color values (text styles are in `protocol::text`).
crate::text Text alignment, kerning, overflow, case, line height and metrics.
